Storefront and customer routes of the unsubscribe module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/unsubscribe

Unsubscribe via the email footer link

Parameters:

- `locale` in query (string, required).
- `token` in query (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.
- `302`: Redirect to the preference center.

## POST /v1/unsubscribe

One-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058)

Parameters:

- `token` in query (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Opted out.
- `400`: Invalid token.
